time: All SLA timers are wall-clock hours in SIM time (see sim/clock.py). Timer starts when the deal enters the stage.

required_to_exit: government photo ID for each guarantor
checks: extract borrower, amount, purpose, product, term, guarantor
every required doc present and legible
application facts match supporting documents (name, EIN, amount, guarantor)

required_to_exit: bank statements for the 6 most recent full months (all pages)
most recent business tax return — OR — IRS extension (Form 7004) if the business is < 2 years old

human_gate.who: assigned credit officer (backup if out of office)

required_to_exit: credit memo (system-written summary of what was seen, decided and why)

human_gate.who: delegated approver or committee chair (by amount)

required_to_exit: product and pricing chosen and consistent with the request
equipment loans: vendor quote present; vendor identity and remit-to account verified against known vendors
commitment letter signed by relationship manager and borrower
disbursement account verified (borrower's own account or verified vendor)

fraud_hold.system_role: DealPilot may flag and REQUEST a hold with evidence; a human places or releases it
fraud_hold.deadline: a suspicious deal must be held before it enters Closed

alert_must_say: which stage and for how long

priority: Respect stated 'funds needed by' dates — a good deal that misses its date is a failure too.
